sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No candidate is verified as the canonical applicability/classification term for a deck, tank top, tank bottom, or bulkhead used in lieu of a frame.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Encode the omitted alternative for a deck, tank top, tank bottom, or bulkhead used in lieu of a frame: target the substitute component’s plate thickness, use adjacentFrameHeight and C = 805, and apply the same maximum of the calculated value, half net shell-plating thickness, and 9 mm. Locate canonical applicability/type and substitute plate-thickness terms via the matcher.
